excluded_objects: all other original or added meshes
coordinate_units: World values metres at the builder-declared scale; source native values uncalibrated.
rotation_axis_source: Independent source barrel fit; neither world Y assumption nor visual centroid.
method: BVHTree.FromPolygons on original textured triangle surfaces; overlap epsilon=0; guard held fixed; no convex hull, cage filling or mesh repair.
bearing_classification: Pair is central only if every vertex of BOTH triangles has radius <.05 source units from the fitted axis. Crossing triangles count outside.

guard.method: Conservative full-rotation cylindrical swept enclosure with exact linear triangle clipping to expanded axial slab; projected convex-polygon distance to axis.
guard.proof_basis: Axial coordinate is affine on every rotor triangle and invariant under rotation; radial norm is convex and rotation invariant. Thus all rotor points at all angles stay in the declared axial slab and maximum-radius cylinder.
guard.scope: Only separation of the tested triangle surfaces outside the declared central cylinder over rigid rotation about this exact axis. Candidates mean unproven by this coarse enclosure, not confirmed intersections. Does not certify closed solids, extra bearings, other link pairs, dynamics, or calibrated real dimensions.

motor_head.method: Conservative full-rotation cylindrical swept enclosure with exact linear triangle clipping to expanded axial slab; projected convex-polygon distance to axis.
motor_head.proof_basis: Axial coordinate is affine on every rotor triangle and invariant under rotation; radial norm is convex and rotation invariant. Thus all rotor points at all angles stay in the declared axial slab and maximum-radius cylinder.
motor_head.scope: Only separation of the tested triangle surfaces outside the declared central cylinder over rigid rotation about this exact axis. Candidates mean unproven by this coarse enclosure, not confirmed intersections. Does not certify closed solids, extra bearings, other link pairs, dynamics, or calibrated real dimensions.

distance_method: Deterministic index-stratified original vertices plus triangle centroids, both directions, outside central bearing radius, nearest triangle queries. Sampled minimum is an upper bound on true minimum distance, not a guaranteed clearance.
limitations: Discrete 5-degree sampling does not certify continuous motion between poses.
BVH surface overlap does not fully prove solid-volume nonpenetration; open/nonmanifold source surfaces are recorded.
Only rotor vs guard and rotor vs motor_head original surfaces are checked; added bearings, support, ground and other link pairs are excluded.
Polygon/triangle connectivity inventory highlights fragments but does not assign mechanical semantics automatically.
No exact positive clearance lower bound or physical dynamic/balance claim is made.

rotor.component_definition: Triangle connectivity through shared stored vertices; no tolerance welding or geometry repair.
